choice.basis: The chart shows that Week 1 revenue at Cafe C is approximately 440, which is below the average line (550). This indicates Week 1 did not exceed average revenue, so it should not be routed to an above-average promotion follow-up. It also did not show a low-revenue response as Week 4 is the lowest at ~240. Therefore, the most appropriate route is to keep Week 1 on normal revenue tracking.
choice.option_label: Keep Week 1 on normal revenue tracking
